name: Aria Hekia
bio:
Aria Hekia's motorsport journey began amidst the roaring engines of grassroots racing in New Zealand. Growing up near a local circuit, she was captivated by the blend of technical precision and raw competitive spirit. Armed with a degree in mechanical engineering, Aria quickly transitioned from building engines to deciphering race data, honing her strategic acumen in smaller teams before landing a coveted role at Walkinshaw Andretti United. 

Known for her meticulous preparation and data-driven approach, Aria thrives under pressure. She believes in empowering her team with clear objectives and fostering open communication. While respected for her expertise, Aria is also known for her unwavering commitment to excellence, sometimes bordering on demanding, as she pushes her colleagues to reach their full potential. Her ability to anticipate and adapt to changing race conditions makes her a valuable asset to the team.

physical.hairStyle: Long, thick hair usually tied back in a practical braid.
physical.description: Aria is a tall woman with a strong, athletic build and a focused gaze.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with handwritten notes and calculations.
Has a habit of tapping her pen rapidly when deep in thought.
Insists on a specific brand of green tea before every race.
